legenda: The 1981 amendment replaced the bond vote with a single ballot proposition carrying the total cost.
nota: No BASIS (cópia local de 23/09; conferido no navegador do app em 26/09): 'Secs. 44.06.100 – 44.06.299 … [Repealed, § 1 ch 54 SLA 1981.]'.
narracao: In 1981, the legislature rewrote the rules. There would be no bond vote this time.

conferencia.prova: "The FRANK Initiative was amended by the Legislature in 1981 to permit the expenditure of state money for the relocation … only if a majority of those voting at the 1982 General Election on a proposition … approve a ballot proposition that includes the total cost…"
